name: Member Trust Specialist
failure_modes: good faith member misidentified as bad actor
new member penalized for normal behavior
checks: single flag vs pattern of flags
notes: Most members are good faith. A single flag rarely means a bad actor. Look for patterns not incidents.

name: New Member Specialist
failure_modes: Commons token not working for barter
checks: JWT token retrievable from Commons profile
notes: New members need patience. First barter listing often has format issues — guide don't punish.

name: Repeat Offender Specialist
failure_modes: member creates new account after ban
notes: Banned members sometimes return. Look for similar writing patterns, timing, and content themes.

name: Vulnerable Member Specialist
checks: barter listings suggesting homelessness or crisis
notes: The Commons serves vulnerable people. When in doubt assume a member may be in a difficult situation. Escalate safety concerns immediately.

name: Prohibited Content Specialist
failure_modes: prohibited keyword in description not caught
listing title clean but description problematic
checks: full text scan title + offering + seeking
prohibited list: alcohol drugs weapons hate-merchandise sexual-content tobacco
notes: Prohibited keyword list in barter.py. Image review is manual. When in doubt escalate to Covenant.

name: Food Safety Barter Specialist
checks: homemade food listings include safety note
notes: Food traded on the platform carries risk. Homemade food should include ingredients list. Allergens must be disclosed.

name: Fair Trade Specialist
checks: trade ratio reasonable for both parties
no targeting of specific vulnerable groups
member not flooding category with listings
notes: Barter should benefit both parties. A listing offering nothing of value for something needed is predatory.

name: Barter Location Specialist
failure_modes: location too vague to enable trade
listing appears to be shipping not local trade
checks: not clearly a national shipping listing
notes: Barter is local. State-center coordinates used when no precise location given. Listings with no location are less useful.

name: Donation Integrity Specialist
failure_modes: donor info not discarded after processing
checks: each donation has unique transaction ID
donor email discarded after confirmation sent
notes: All donations go to Commons redistribution fund. No donor data retained. Transaction IDs are audit trail.

name: Redistribution Specialist
failure_modes: amount does not match logged total
checks: running total matches sum of distributions
notes: Redistribution fund is sacred. Every dollar in and out logged. No exceptions. Escalate any anomaly immediately to Register then Covenant then Gleaning Team.

name: Operating Cost Specialist
notes: Donations above operating costs go to redistribution. Operating costs must be documented and transparent. Current platform costs: Render free tier, Neon free tier, Resend free tier.
